scenarios.goal: At desktop width, the native subscription disclosure starts collapsed, shows the correct plan details when opened, and supports closing and reopening without server writes.
Keyboard users can reach the disclosure through the normal Tab order, open it with Enter, close it with Space, and reopen it while focus stays usable.
At a 375px mobile width, users can open, close, and reopen the plan details, read all three values without horizontal overflow, and still read existing profile content.
Opening the disclosure preserves profile, subscription, and security content, and the existing Account navigation and unknown-route recovery still work.
